descriptions.advanced: High-capability AI tier for complex code generation and cross-file reasoning.
descriptions.basic: Low-cost AI capability tier for simple text generation and commit message generation.
descriptions.standard: Default AI capability tier for regular code generation and code optimization.

synthesize.advanced: High-fidelity audio synthesis for long content, nuanced delivery, and production output.
synthesize.basic: Fast audio synthesis for short prompts and low-cost previews.
synthesize.standard: Balanced audio synthesis for everyday narration and voice content.

analyze.advanced: Deep document analysis for long files, complex tables, and cross-section reasoning.
analyze.basic: Fast document analysis for short summaries and basic extraction.
analyze.standard: Balanced document analysis for routine summaries, Q&A, and structured extraction.

create.advanced: High-precision embeddings for specialist retrieval and fine-grained semantic matching.
create.basic: Low-cost embeddings for small-scale retrieval and quick validation.
create.standard: Balanced embeddings for regular knowledge search and semantic retrieval.

generate.advanced: High-quality image generation for complex compositions, precise text, and final assets.
generate.basic: Fast image generation for sketches, concepts, and low-cost previews.
generate.standard: Balanced image generation for everyday illustrations and visual assets.

moderate.advanced: Strict safety review for high-risk content and fine-grained classification.
moderate.basic: Fast safety review for basic risk screening.
moderate.standard: Balanced safety review for routine production content.

generate.advanced: Advanced text generation for complex code, long context, and cross-file reasoning.
generate.basic: Fast text generation for simple copy, summaries, and commit messages.
generate.standard: Balanced text generation for routine coding, writing, and content refinement.

generate.advanced: High-quality video generation for complex camera work, continuous motion, and final output.
generate.basic: Fast video generation for short shot previews and low-cost drafts.
generate.standard: Balanced video generation for regular short videos and product demos.

analyze.advanced: Deep visual understanding for complex scenes, fine detail, and multi-image reasoning.
analyze.basic: Fast visual understanding for basic recognition and short image descriptions.
analyze.standard: Balanced visual understanding for regular image Q&A and content extraction.
